attacks.name: Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!critical| |!wild| |*Throw|: Before |!damage| is dealt, this character may Throw the defender |!movement_small|.

attacks.name: Mind Spike
steps: After this attack is resolved, Advance the defender |!movement_small|.

attacks.name: Atomic Singularity
steps: After this attack is resolved, the defender and each other character within |!range| 2 of it suffer 2 |!damage|.

superPowers.name: Mass Mind Control (Affiliation: Onslaught's Grip)
superPowers.body: If |*Onslaught| is included in a Squad, that Squad is affiliated with |*Onslaught's Grip| and must use this |!leadership|. When another allied character is Dazed or KO'd by an enemy effect, this character gains |!power| equal to its |!threat|.

superPowers.name: Astral Teleportation
superPowers.body: Place this character within |!range| 5 of its current position. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Magnetic Projection
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 4 or less within |!range| 4 and Throw it |!movement_large|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Psychic Driver
superPowers.body: After an attack targeting another allied character is resolved, this character may use this superpower. Advance that allied character Toward the attacker |!movement_small|. A character can be Advanced by this superpower only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Material Astral Manipulation
superPowers.body: When this character would suffer 1 or more |!damage| from an enemy effect, reduce the amount of |!damage| suffered by 1. Additionally, during the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 2 additional |!power|.
